Name: Project Valley Life
Author: Jessebot
TagLine: Valley Life adds new farm map, remasters the farmhouse, greenhouse, and cellar. This is all CONFIGURABLE through a config.json. Requires SMAPI/Content Patcher.
Description:
OK, guys i think i have fixed that major bug. idk try now.

(WIP)btw: Project Valley Life is being reworked. There will be a legacy download for people who still like this version instead of the new version im creating. this page will be removed after i rework it and release it on Nexus Mods so don't be shocked (it will be renamed to "Valley Life").

Valley Life **adds a new farm map **__(replacing standard farm)__, **remasters** the**farmhouse, greenhouse, cellar and adds in a new attic for 2nd farmhouse upgrade**. This is all **CONFIGURABLE** through a _config.json_ file so turn on and off whatever you like. _**Requires SMAPI/Content Patcher**_.

Something you don't like about this mod or you have something better (like a different farmhouse mod you would prefer to use)? Well this is **ALL CONFIGURABLE through the CONFIG.JSON file. ___See the article/readme.txt for detailed instructions.

___**Tested with _**SMAPI 2.7, Content Patcher 1.4, and Stardew Valley 1.3.28.

FEATURES:
**_-new farm map replacing standard farm (with swimming pools and etc.)
-starting farmhouse has a kitchen
-large farmhouse has a dollhouse & attic
-expanded greenhouse
-expanded cellar
___****___**MAIN FEATURE IS THE FARM MAP**
